rows.grounds: compound spanning the whole range of existence
possessing the state of identity with Bhairava

items.question: How is the one reality related to the entire path from Śiva to the individual?
premises: There is one reality that pervades all levels from Śiva down to the individual.
This same reality constitutes the entire path.
The entire path abides in non-difference from Bhairava.
items.inference: The one all-pervading reality is identical with the entire path and remains non-different from Bhairava.
items.plain_english: The one reality, present in every state from Śiva to the limited individual, is this entire path itself, abiding in non-difference from Bhairava.

rows.grounds: situated in the subject's own form
identified as the mantra path; iti fused

items.question: How does the one reality manifest as the path of mantras?
premises: The reality manifests by virtue of its own freedom.
In manifesting, it assumes autonomy.
When abiding in the nature of the knowing subject, it is recognized as the path of mantras.
items.inference: Through its own freedom, the reality appears as autonomous and, in the subject's mode, is recognized as the mantra path.
items.plain_english: By its own freedom, that same reality shines forth as autonomous; when it abides in the form of the knowing subject, it is recognized as the path of mantras.

rows.grounds: in the mode of knowledge itself
identified as the phoneme path; iti fused
the form of the instrument of cognition
the condition of being the word path

items.question: How does the same reality become the paths of phonemes and words?
premises: In the form of valid cognition, the reality is declared to be the path of phonemes.
When it assumes the form of the means of knowledge, it becomes the path of words.
items.inference: The same reality appears as the phoneme path in the mode of cognition and as the word path in the mode of the cognitive instrument.
items.plain_english: In the form of valid cognition, this reality is called the path of phonemes; when it takes the form of the means of knowledge, it becomes the path of words.

rows.grounds: the absorbed state of being the cognitive instrument

items.question: How does the reality become the path of limited powers while still linked to the knower?
premises: The reality does not abandon its immersion in the form of the means of knowledge.
It moves toward objecthood through association with conceptualization.
In that state, joined with the knower, it is the path of limited powers.
items.inference: Retaining its role as cognitive instrument while taking on objecthood through conceptualization, the reality becomes the kalā path in relation to the knower.
items.plain_english: Without abandoning its role as the means of knowledge, it moves toward objecthood through conceptualization; joined with the knower, it becomes the path of limited powers.

rows.grounds: in the pure or unmixed state
when joined with being a knowable object
identified as the tattva path; iti fused
should be grasped or taken as
by association with serving as the basis of that coarseness
identified as the bhuvana path; iti fused

items.question: When is the reality understood as the paths of principles and worlds?
premises: In a pure connection with objecthood, the reality is to be understood as the path of principles.
When connected with serving as the support of that grossness, it is described as the path of worlds.
items.inference: The same reality appears as the tattva path in pure objecthood and as the bhuvana path when it supports gross manifestation.
items.plain_english: When it is purely connected with objecthood, it should be understood as the path of principles; when it serves as the support of that grossness, it is described as the path of worlds.

rows.grounds: the condition of what can be spoken
devoted to knowing and saving grounded in Śiva's powers of knowledge and action

items.question: Under what condition does the expressible state become absorbed in conscious awareness?
premises: The state of the expressible can be swallowed by the reflective awareness of consciousness.
This occurs when that state is intent on cognition and protection dependent on Śiva's knowledge and action.
items.inference: When oriented toward Śiva's powers of knowledge and action, the expressible state is absorbed into conscious reflective awareness.
items.plain_english: For when the state of what can be expressed is swallowed by the reflective awareness of consciousness, it becomes intent on cognition and protection grounded in Śiva's knowledge and action.

rows.grounds: because of adeptness in the playful activity of all powers

items.question: How does the Śiva-natured mantra path first arise?
premises: The reality possesses skill in the eager play of all its powers.
From that skill, the mantra path arises forcefully and quickly.
This first arising is of the nature of Śiva.
items.inference: Through the playful skill of all its powers, the Śiva-natured mantra path arises first and swiftly.
items.plain_english: From its skill in the eager play of all its powers, the mantra path, whose nature is Śiva, first arises swiftly and with force.

rows.grounds: possessing the enjoyment of repose in pure, rising awareness
because of the power to express everything

items.question: Why are the powers unrestricted for the one resting in pure consciousness?
premises: There is one whose relish is repose in surging consciousness alone.
That state has the capacity for all naming.
From that capacity, the powers are unrestricted.
items.inference: Because pure conscious repose entails the capacity to name all, its powers operate without restriction.
items.plain_english: For the one who relishes repose in surging consciousness alone, the powers are unrestricted because of the capacity to name everything.

rows.grounds: functioning from self-coemergent meanings down to the level of earth
the shining or unfolding of awareness
meanings or things; elided initial vowel

items.question: What range of objects do the emanated powers encompass within consciousness?
premises: Powers are emanated whose operations extend from self-coemergent meanings down to the earth.
These operations occur within the play of consciousness.
They encompass corresponding objects within their own self-nature.
items.inference: The emanated powers span the full range of objects, from subtle self-arising meanings to gross earth, all within consciousness.
items.plain_english: The powers are emanated with operations ranging from meanings that arise with the self down to the earth, encompassing all those objects within the play of consciousness in their own self.

items.question: Do beings without linguistic convention still possess real cognitive awareness?
premises: Infants and even animal knowers do not partake in linguistic convention.
They apprehend objects reflectively.
In doing so, they bear a real consciousness in the form of valid cognition.
items.inference: Even without conventional language, infants and animals possess real cognitive awareness.
items.plain_english: Infants and even animal knowers, who have no share in linguistic convention, still apprehend things and bear a real consciousness in the form of valid cognition.

rows.grounds: having an innate, non-artificial formative core

items.question: How do pre-conventional beings attain varied subjecthood?
premises: Even pre-conventional beings possess their own consciousness.
This consciousness has an uncontrived formative essence and is both differentiated and undifferentiated.
Relying on this consciousness, they attain varied subjecthood.
items.inference: By relying on their innate, both-differentiated-and-undifferentiated consciousness, pre-conventional beings attain varied forms of subjecthood.
items.plain_english: Even they, relying on this own consciousness of theirs—whose essence is an uncontrived impression and which is both differentiated and undifferentiated—attain a varied state of being knowers.

rows.grounds: in the innate awareness consisting of limitless phonemes
the state of being rooted or established
reach, come to; sandhi before vowel

items.question: What happens when linguistic conventions become rooted in innate phonemic consciousness?
premises: There is an uncontrived consciousness of infinite phonemes.
Linguistic conventions can become firmly established in that consciousness.
When so established, those conventions attain a non-conventional mode of operation.
items.inference: Conventions grounded in innate phonemic consciousness transcend mere conventionality in their operation.
items.plain_english: If linguistic conventions become firmly established in this uncontrived consciousness of infinite phonemes, then even they come to operate in a non-conventional way.

rows.grounds: due to dependence on further conventions

items.question: Why can linguistic conventions not find stable rest without innate consciousness?
premises: Many conventions can be made without this innate consciousness.
Such conventions depend on other conventions.
Dependence on further conventions prevents stable rest in the mind.
items.inference: Without grounding in innate consciousness, conventions cannot achieve stable mental rest because they require endless further conventions.
items.plain_english: But without this innate consciousness, all the many conventions that are made could never find rest in the mind, because they would depend on yet other conventions.

rows.grounds: due to infinite regress or lack of stable ground
since it would undermine the foundation
with regard to a linguistic convention
from what basis, by what means

items.question: How could a child be instructed in convention if conventions lack a stable foundation?
premises: Conventions without innate grounding lead to infinite regress.
Infinite regress destroys the root of understanding.
Instruction of a child in convention presupposes a stable foundation.
items.inference: If conventions rested only on other conventions, infinite regress would make it impossible to instruct a child in them.
items.plain_english: They would never find rest, because of infinite regress and because that would destroy the very root; so how, indeed, could a child even be instructed in a convention?

rows.grounds: for that reason limitless; sandhi with following particle
attended by the self-reflection of consciousness

items.question: What is the nature of the phonemic ground that makes convention possible?
premises: Conventions require a stable, non-regressive ground.
There is an infinite, non-māyic collection of phonemes of this kind.
This phonemic collection is always accompanied by conscious reflective awareness and continually unfolds.
items.inference: The stable ground of convention is an infinite, non-māyic phonemic totality that perpetually unfolds with conscious reflective awareness.
items.plain_english: Therefore, this infinite, non-māyic collection of phonemes, accompanied by the reflective awareness of consciousness, is always unfolding.

rows.grounds: they brought forth, extended into being

items.question: What is the relationship between non-māyic and māyic phonemes?
premises: The māyic phonemes arise from the non-māyic phonemic source.
The non-māyic phonemes are the power behind the māyic phonemes.
items.inference: Māyic phonemes originate from the non-māyic phonemic totality, which constitutes their underlying potency.
items.plain_english: And from that very source the māyic phonemes came into being; it is understood that those non-māyic phonemes are indeed their power.

rows.grounds: having been heard; sandhi before vowel
that person does not; sandhi fusion
with respect to that object or meaning

items.question: Why does hearing another's speech fail to produce subjecthood in some listeners?
premises: When others' utterances are heard, a listener's own cognition may remain veiled.
A person whose own cognition is veiled remains dull with respect to that meaning.
Such a person does not attain subjecthood in relation to that meaning.
items.inference: Mere hearing of others' speech does not confer subjecthood if one's own cognition does not awaken to the meaning.
items.plain_english: For when others' utterances are heard, if one's own cognition remains veiled, that dull person does not become a knowing subject with respect to that meaning.

rows.grounds: into the aggregate of māyic sounds

items.question: What enables a listener to attain subjecthood through heard speech?
premises: A listener may have their own cognition enter into awareness.
That cognition, containing differentiation, enters the mass of māyic phonemes within oneself.
Through this entry, the listener attains subjecthood.
items.inference: Subjecthood arises when one's own differentiated cognition awakens and engages the māyic phonemes from within.
items.plain_english: But if one's own cognition, bearing differentiation within it, enters into awareness within one's own mass of māyic phonemes, that person attains the state of being a knower.

items.question: What determines the degree of aesthetic wonder in cognition?
premises: The uncreated, innate form can predominate to varying degrees.
The degree of aesthetic wonder corresponds to that predominance.
items.inference: The more the uncreated innate form predominates, the greater the gradation of aesthetic wonder that arises.
items.plain_english: To the extent that the uncreated, innate form predominates, to that same extent a gradation of aesthetic wonder is produced.

rows.grounds: in the state of creative intuition
the brilliance of being a poet and speaker

items.question: What results when the surge of the innate form becomes great in intuitive insight?
premises: The innate form can surge to a great degree.
Some become established in the nature of flash insight.
Such establishment leads to excellence in poetry and eloquence.
items.inference: When the surge of the innate form is great, those established in intuitive insight certainly attain complete poetic and eloquent excellence.
items.plain_english: But when that surge becomes great, those established in the nature of intuitive insight certainly attain, in every way, excellence in poetry and eloquence.

rows.grounds: for that reason, by that means

items.question: Why are the phonemes contemplated and kept secret in the perfection of speech?
premises: The perfection of speech depends on the phonemes.
Therefore the phonemes are objects of contemplative practice.
For that reason they are kept secret and spoken only by the initiated.
items.inference: Because phonemes are the basis of perfected speech, they are contemplatively cultivated and transmitted under secrecy.
items.plain_english: Therefore, in the perfection of speech, the phonemes are contemplated; for that very reason they are kept secret and spoken only by one who maintains secrecy.

rows.grounds: to the extent that the all-pervading Lord's; compound
firmly set in completing shares of enjoyment

items.question: What occurs when the Lord's constant repose projects many phonemes at once?
premises: The Lord has a constant repose.
From that repose, many phonemes can be projected simultaneously.
These phonemes are well established in fulfilling portions of experience.
items.inference: The Lord's abiding repose simultaneously projects multiple phonemes that are structured to fulfill experiential portions.
uncertainties: The gerund 'udṛṅkya' is morphologically unusual; taken here as 'having projected forth'.
items.plain_english: Then, insofar as there is the Lord's constant repose, it projects many phonemes at once, well established in fulfilling the portions of experience.

rows.grounds: the domain of what is known
in the aggregate of worldly, inert conventions

items.question: How does the path of words become the first sprout of worldly convention?
premises: The path of words resorts to the level of the knowable object.
At that level it enters the mass of conventions bound to transmigratory life.
In that mass it functions as the first sprout.
items.inference: When the word path takes support in objectivity, it becomes the initial sprout of the aggregate of worldly conventions.
uncertainties: The compound 'saṃsāramṛtasaṃketasaṃghāte' is compact; interpreted as conventions inert within transmigratory existence.
items.plain_english: To that extent, this path of words, resting on the level of the object, becomes the first sprout within the mass of conventions bound up with worldly existence.

rows.grounds: the condition of being the means of knowledge
of the group of tattvas; iti fused

items.question: How are objecthood, subjecthood, and measure related to the thirty-six principles?
premises: Objecthood, subjecthood, and the state of being the measure have been described.
These modes pertain to the collection of thirty-six principles.
items.inference: It is concluded that objecthood, subjecthood, and measure are modes within the thirty-sixfold system of principles.
items.plain_english: Thus it is ascertained that objecthood, the state of being the knower, and the state of being the means of knowledge all belong to the thirty-sixfold collection of principles.
